paragraphs.body: Yahoo Sports reports that Baker Mayfield delivered a brutally honest performance after the Tampa Bay Buccaneers' Week 8 loss to the Atlanta Falcons, where he recorded zero completions. The team achieved a rare feat not seen since 1974, a statistic SB Nation and Sky Sports highlight as a historic anomaly in NFL history. Despite the statistical infamy, Mayfield stated in a press conference that he does not care how the Buccaneers won the game, emphasizing that 'whatever it takes' is required to win. He maintained this stance even as analysts revisited the strangest game in NFL history following the no-pass outcome.

headline: Baker Mayfield's historic zero-completion game against the Falcons leaves him focused solely on winning, regardless of the team's victory.
